text:
Looking at the TOOLS.md file, I can see the port configuration for the live Kimi server.

In the serving section, it states:
```
tools/serve_kimi_local.sh [start|stop|status]
    KIMI_CACHE_MB=4096   expert cache budget (Phase 8 default)
    KIMI_PORT=18080      server port
    KIMI_CTX=8192        context size
```

This shows that the live Kimi server listens on port 18080 by default.

18080
